description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Valentin, adding {B}.
Choose to return Valentin to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Valentin from the command zone by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
